newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan June motorcycle output down 3.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan June motorcycle output down 3.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle production fell 3.5 percent in June from a year earlier to 227,265 motorcycles, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA) said on Thursday.
Motorcycle output fell in June for the fifth successive month on a year-on-year basis.

Domestic motorcycle sales fell 8.1 percent in June from a year earlier to 99,352 units.
JAMA said it expected Japanese motorcycle exports in June to have fallen about eight percent from a year earlier.
It will announce export figures on July 28.
Japan's motorcycle production in the January to June period totalled 1.29 million, down 2.8 percent from a year earlier.

The January-June output included two motorcycles made by smaller makers against 23 a year earlier.
Domestic motorcycle sales fell 2.1 percent in January-June to 644,621 units compared with a year earlier.
Japan's motorcycle exports in January-June were expected to have fallen about one percent from a year earlier.
